assertions.name: fibonacci_polynomial_divisibility_equivalence
assertions.source: b_a | b_n <=> a | n verified exactly over a,n in {3,5,7,9,11} in Z[h] (integer polynomial division, remainder zero iff a|n).

assertions.name: b3_divides_b9_harmonic
assertions.source: b_9 = b_3 * (h^6+6h^4+9h^2+1): winding 9 factors through winding 3 (the harmonic of generation 1).

assertions.name: b3_does_not_divide_b5
assertions.source: Prime winding 5 is non-harmonic (unit remainder -1 mod b_3).

assertions.name: b3_does_not_divide_b7
assertions.source: Prime winding 7 is non-harmonic (unit remainder -1 mod b_3).

assertions.name: unique_harmonic_in_genus_window_is_T29
assertions.source: Exactly one of {3,5,7,9} factors through a smaller odd winding in the set -- n=9, the unique composite -- so the generation count 3 is derived from the genus bound plus the continuant divisibility.

description: Route A of the three-generation question (bean qou-x4qm): DERIVES the asserted 'odd primes' condition at the normal-form level. The Morgan-Voyce continuant b_n (the sigma-coefficient of the GS normal form of T(2,n), prop:lepton-continuant-recurrence) satisfies the Fibonacci-polynomial divisibility b_a | b_n <=> a | n over Z[h]. Among the genus-admissible odd windings {3,5,7,9}, 9=3*3 is the unique composite and b_9 = b_3 * (h^6+6h^4+9h^2+1); 3,5,7 are prime and mutually non-divisible. This is the precise, exact-arithmetic form of 'sigma^9=(sigma^3)^3 is a harmonic of generation 1'. Sorry-free Lean twin: QOU/Archimedean/lepton_continuant_generation_exclusion.lean. SCOPE-(a): derives the factorisation distinction, NOT that T(2,9) is unphysical (prime knot, genus 4); the net->mass map stays open (sibling witness generation-count-t29-truncation, validation FAILED, not patched).

harmonic_factorisation_of_T29.reading: winding 9's normal-form coefficient is a multiple of winding 3's -- the exact form of the 'harmonic of generation 1' hypothesis; b_3 | b_9.

prime_windings_are_nonharmonic.reading: b_5, b_7 leave a +-1 (unit) remainder mod b_3, so b_3 -- degree 2, not a unit of Z[h] -- cannot divide them. 3, 5, 7 are prime: no proper odd divisor > 1, hence mutually non-divisible.

consequence_three_generations.derived_statement: the generation windings are exactly the odd windings whose continuant coefficient does NOT factor through a smaller one, i.e. the odd primes {3,5,7}; T(2,9) is the unique harmonic and is excluded. This DERIVES the dictionary's asserted '(odd primes)'.

honest_residual_gap.what_is_closed: the corpus's asserted-not-derived primality parenthetical, now a normal-form theorem.
honest_residual_gap.what_stays_open: the physical bridge 'normal-form-independent winding => physical generation', and the net->mass map (sibling probe validation FAILED). Scope-(a): this does not exclude T(2,9) as a knot/state (bean qou-x4qm).
